Hello, I’m Carmen!

I’m a marketing professional originally from Santa Cruz, Bolivia, currently pursuing a Master of Science in Digital Marketing & Analytics at California State Polytechnic University, Pomona.

With a bachelor’s degree in Commercial Engineering and professional experience in commercial management, marketing strategy, and customer service, I bring a business-oriented perspective to digital marketing and analytics.

Throughout my professional journey, I have developed a passion for understanding customers, identifying market opportunities, and creating strategies that help businesses grow.

Today, I’m expanding my analytical and technical skills to connect marketing decisions with data-driven insights.
